However, Qinhuangdao, Chengde, Zhangjiakou, and other cities have low participation in the financial development of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei, and have not achieved better development in the financial agglomeration of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei. Shijiazhuang, Tangshan, Hengshui and Chengde have played a bridge role in the financial agglomeration network. For this reason, it is necessary to accelerate the construction of Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei financial agglomeration centers to narrow the differences in financial development among city cluster, and play the spatial correlation and synergistic effect of financial agglomeration in Beijing-Tianjin-Hebei city cluster have been studied to promote the synergistic development.

articleTitle: Implementation of aerodynamic identification technology based on the fastest descent method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Based on operator theory and numerical iteration technology, this paper quickly completes the identification of aerodynamic equivalent kernel functions with input-and-output data from the computational fluid dynamics code (CFD code). The convergence criterion of the numerical calculation is whether the error between identified forces and the given experimental data is acceptable, namely a rather accuracy. Compared with the classical impulse response method or step response method, our method does not attempt to directly identify the exact kernel functions of the system, but to approach to those approximation, namely, the equivalent kernel functions. Several examples are given to show this new technique to obtain their kernel functions, including a classic circuit system described by ordinal differential equations (Ode) and flow field analysis in the case with a variable Mach number. Once the system feature extraction is complete, the response is immediately obtained by the well-known convolution operator.

articleTitle: A deep reinforcement learning method based on attentional memories
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In continuous visual decision-making scenarios, the environment is often partially observable rather than globally observable, and traditional deep reinforcement learning methods are often unable to effectively learn to discover hidden information in partially observable environments. In this work, a continuous visual decision-making algorithm AMU-DQN for partially observable environments is proposed by combining the proposed attentional memories unit(AMU) which can integrate temporal and spatial features in historical sequences and deep Q-network. Due to the special mechanism of the AMU recurrent layer, the AMU-DQN algorithm has the ability to learn favorable hidden information from the historical observation information sequence in a partially observable environment, forming a special attention and memory ability. Extensive simulation experiments show that AMU-DQN exhibits super-high performance in both convergence speed and reward convergence peak.

articleTitle: Improving Long-lead ENSO Prediction with Joint ENSO Transformer
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Prediction of El Niño-Southern Oscillation (ENSO) events in sufficient advance time will facilitate early planning to mitigate its adverse impacts on agriculture, marine ecosystems and public safety. Recent studies show that deep learning models have great potential for ENSO prediction. However, the one year advance forecasting of ENSO remains challenging and previous task settings could not output multiple-month forecasts concurrently. In this letter, we propose the Joint ENSO transformer (JETR) to promote long-lead ENSO prediction. JETR contains pretext task to generate more data and balances the complex spatiotemporal association of ENSO in main task. By jointly training the pretext task with the main task, the model can skillfully output oceanic Niño index (ONI) for 24 months simultaneously. Experimental results also suggest that the proposed JETR model can predict long-lead ENSO with higher correlation compared with other deep learning models.

articleTitle: The Implementation of Movies and TV Plays Analysis System Combined with Knowledge Graph and Data Visualization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: More and more movies and television plays have been produced in recent years, but a few have succeeded in the market. Therefore, the analysis and speculation of the success factors of movies and television plays are very important for the producers and investors. The existing analysis platform only analyzes the benefits generated by movies and television dramas in a certain period and lacks the ability of prediction and reasoning. To analyze the key factors affecting the success of movies and television dramas and provide a reference for producers and investors, we design and implement a movies and television plays analysis system combined with a knowledge graph and data visualization technology. First of all, we crawl the information of movies and television plays and user comments on the Douban website; Then, the entities and relationships are extracted by OpenUE toolkit, and Neo4j is used to construct and store the knowledge graph in movies and television plays. On this basis, we utilize the improved TransR algorithm for knowledge completion and reasoning. Finally, combined with the knowledge graph, we analyze the success factors of popular movies and TV plays and visualize the analysis results in various chart types.

articleTitle: An improved Multi-objective Grey Wolf Optimization Algorithm Based on Multiple Strategies
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: According to the disadvantages of the grey wolf algorithm (GWO) in solving multi-objective optimization problems, such as slow convergence, easy to fall into local optimum and poor diversity of solution sets, an improved grey wolf algorithm based on multiple strategies (I-MOGWO) is proposed to solve multi-objective optimization problems. It mainly includes: clustering the non-dominated individuals in the external archive set based on reference points, selecting the head wolves that guide the search according to the size of the density value of the clusters to improve the convergence speed, and using the mutation operator to perturb the position of the search agent so that it can jump out of the local optimum and improve the global exploration ability of the algorithm. The mechanism of crowding distance mechanism is applied to maintain the external archive size and keep the solution set diversity. Experimental results show that the proposed algorithm can not only effectively approximate the real Pareto front of the problem, but also the obtained Pareto optimal solutions have better distribution and diversity.

articleTitle: Safety evaluation of naval ship wire rope based on safety factor
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Steel wire rope is widely used in ship mechanical equipment. Due to various reasons, steel wire ropes often suffer from different types and degrees of damage during use. Its safety is directly related to the normal operation of ship mechanical equipment and the safety of human life. Firstly, this paper analyzes the damage types and characteristics of naval steel wire rope and its influence on the strength and stress performance of steel wire rope. Aiming at the broken wire, wear and corrosion damage of steel wire rope, this paper puts forward the reliability evaluation system of steel wire rope based on safety factor, namely static safety factor and dynamic safety factor. On this basis, some research suggestions on the replacement and scrapping of ship wire ropes are given, which can not only reduce the waste of resources, but also ensure the safe and reliable operation of the wire ropes, which has important military and economic value.

articleTitle: Under-Gravity Surface Optimization of Antenna Mesh Reflector
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Large-scale space deployable antenna is becoming more and more urgent with the improving demand in aerospace technology, which requires high surface accuracy of antenna mesh reflector. However, gravity has become one of the main factors that restrict the accuracy with the increasing of antenna aperture. To avoid flipping antenna or extensive experiments to eliminate the effect of gravity in engineering, a new surface optimization method is proposed. The initial vector and characteristic structure for iteration is discussed in detail to ensure the convergence. A tension structure and a typical antenna mesh reflector are simulated as examples. The results can well meet the requirement of surface accuracy.

articleTitle: A New Case Teaching Method for Python Course in Software Engineering based on PBL Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: At present, most students in Software Engineering major are lack of interest in learning Python programming language, and their learning efficiency is not very well. Aim at to solve these two problems, the paper designed a new case teaching method based on PBL model. The new case teaching method guides students with questions, and teaching them how to divide some integrated projects into some smaller functional modules, such as data pre-processing, converting Python ‘dict’ into Python ‘list’, counting words frequency, and data visualization. Along with the new case teaching method, students can learn Python course with styles of ‘small practice, experiment, and integrated project’, so enhance their learning interest, and have better learning effects.

articleTitle: The Value Derivation Mechanism of Urban Comprehensive Energy Data and the Construction of Energy Consumption Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In view of the demand for urban comprehensive energy big data value mining services, it is proposed to use key technologies such as multi-source high-dimensional heterogeneous processing, multi-class energy data fusion prediction based on long-term and short-term neural networks, multi-feature fusion algorithm based on machine learning, and energy data value network model to analyze the typical application scenarios of urban comprehensive energy, conduct in-depth value mining of energy data, and construct the value derivation mechanism of urban comprehensive energy and the energy consumption prediction model of urban comprehensive energy. Provide a theoretical basis for the demonstration construction of urban comprehensive energy intelligent IoT control and application.

articleTitle: Calibration of the initial position angle by back EMF zero crossing method based on DA chip
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: To obtain the accurate rotor position is the key to vector control of permanent magnet synchronous motor in relation to whether motor rotation and the rotation of the motor efficiency, The initial position angle can be observed directly by the zero crossing method of back EMF, the absolute position sensor gets accurately position angle of the rotor of the rotary transformer. and reuse Y-connected three resistance to obtain the back EMF signal of the motor, the oscilloscope to observe the position difference between the time when the rotor position for the decoding circuit is 0° and A phase back EMF over the zero, which can get permanent magnet synchronous motor rotor initial position. In the permanent magnet synchronous motor drive control system, the experimental verification and application of the method is verified, which proves that the method is, accurate and intuitive, simple programming, Reliable engineering application.

articleTitle: Evaluation of coupling coordination degree between tourism industry and cultural industry
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: China's cultural industry and tourism industry are growing stronger, have gradually reached a relatively mature stage, the interactive development of cultural industry and tourism industry has become an important way for the two industries to seek further upgrading. Based on the analysis of the coupling mechanism of the two big industries, by coupling coordination degree of the cultural industry and tourism industry in henan province as the research object, constructing evaluation index system, cultural industry and tourism industry by using the coupling model and coupling coordination model, an analysis of data collected nearly nine years trends, research of henan cultural industry, and coordinating the relationship between the development level of tourism industry. The results are as follows: Since 2017, the development speed of tourism industry in Henan province has significantly increased, and the cultural industry has lagged behind the development of tourism industry. During the past 9 years, the coupling coordination degree of cultural and tourism industry has developed from near maladjustment to good coordination, and the synergistic effect of development has increased gradually.

articleTitle: A Big Data Encryption Method based on Lorenz and Feistel Structures
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: With the development of information technology, the information network has entered the era of big data. The dissemination and storage of a large amount of data will not only create value, but also increase the risk of data leakage. Data privacy protection is an important research topic in the field of network security, and the existing encryption methods make it difficult to give attention to the confidentiality and efficiency of big data encryption at the same time. Therefore, this paper proposes a hybrid encryption method based on the Lorenz system and Feistel structure, which is applied to large data encryption. It takes advantage of the randomness of a chaotic system, the confidentiality of hybrid encryption, and the high efficiency of symmetric encryption to ensure the speed and security of large data encryption at the same time.

articleTitle: Research on student academic precaution model based on IWPA-BP neural network algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In this paper, a Back Propagation (BP) neural network prediction method based on improved wolf swarm algorithm (IWPA) is proposed to study students' academic early warning. The improved wolf pack algorithm has strong search ability, excellent solution ability and fast convergence speed. It can optimize the initial weight and threshold of BP neural network and improve the nonlinear fitting ability of prediction model. The simulation results illustrates that the prediction algorithm has better effectiveness in optimizing accuracy and improving convergence speed in student academic precaution based on UCI data set.

articleTitle: A new hybrid model for short-term volatility forecasting
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: At a time when high-frequency financial data have become increasingly available, short-term volatility forecasting is one of the core issues of financial research. It is an important basis for the pricing, asset allocation, risk management and trading strategy of financial derivatives. The generalized autoregressive conditional heteroskedasticity (GARCH) model is a common instrument to modeling volatility of high-frequency financial time series, which is based on the aggregation characteristics of volatility. At the same time, Support vector regression (SVR) aims to fit a line/curve to data by minimizing a cost function, which is widely used in financial data analysis and prediction, and has good performance. In this paper, a hybrid model of GARCH model and SVR is proposed, in which particle swarm optimization (PSO) algorithm is used to optimize hyperparameters of the support vector regression in the scope of constraint permission. In addition, we also introduce Fourier kernel GARCH-PSO-SVR, and use the Shanghai Composite Index data to evaluate the performance of various GARCH-PSO-SVR models in terms of mean absolute error (MAE) and mean square error (MSE). The experimental results show that the proposed approach outperforms the other competing peer models.

articleTitle: Research on the Construction and Application of Smart Classroom Teaching Service Platform Based on Big Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In order to solve the problems of the independence of online autonomous learning and live teaching, and the lack of data analysis on the website of excellent courses, this paper studies and designs an intelligent teaching service platform based on Django + Vue framework. The platform adopts B2B2C online education mode, and designs four functional systems based on PC and mobile terminals, including student terminal, lecturer terminal, enterprise terminal and platform terminal. The platform uses Python as the data processing language, through the user's behavior, using collaborative filtering recommendation algorithm modeling, to provide personalized recommendation for users. By using data visualization technology and data mining technology, the learning progress and knowledge mastery of students are visualized. The project can provide high-quality free online course resources for student users. Improve the learning effect of students, while bringing traffic to the one-to-one teaching business line of enterprises, help to increase the conversion rate of paying users, and is of great significance to the realization of the whole online education ecological closed-loop.

articleTitle: Research on travel scheme recommendation model based on logistic regression algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: With the gradual improvement of people's living standards, more and more people choose to travel in their spare time to alleviate the pressure and fatigue brought by work. It's impossible for tourists to spend a lot of money on the famous scenic spots, but it's not possible to spend a lot of money on traveling outside the famous scenic spots. In order to enable tourists to enjoy a higher quality travel experience, python natural language analysis is used to reflect the real experience of travel customers, capture and analyze the data of user comments of merchants in various regions, conduct emotional analysis of user comments under each merchant through logical regression algorithm, and analyze the praise keywords and praise rate of each store through word cloud pair, so as to provide the best choice for tourists.

articleTitle: Traffic Collision Avoidance System Warning Risk of Transport and Training Aircraft Based on Related Parallel Approaches
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In order to ensure the safety and efficiency of the transport and training aircraft when operating on the same airport, the TCAS warning risk when the transport and training aircraft perform related parallel approaches is studied. By studying the TCAS warning logic and process, a flight conflict detection model was established; the movement model of the transport and training aircraft in the related parallel approach was established according to the aircraft approach procedures; combined with the runway parameters and aircraft performance data, the Monte Carlo method was used to stochastically Generate a normally distributed set of initial parameters such as aircraft position and speed; through a large number of calculations, the TCAS warning conditions under the current relevant parallel approach regulations and the smaller interval standards are obtained. The results of the study show that the transport aircraft and training aircraft will not trigger the TCAS alarm when performing related parallel approaches on the five sides under the current regulations; from the perspective of the TCAS alarm, the separation standard for the transport and training aircraft in related parallel approaches can be reduced to 1.8km.

articleTitle: Exploring Hierarchical Language Knowledge in Graph Neural Networks for Fake News Detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Fake news can be propagated quickly across online microblogs, resulting in a series of adverse impacts on our daily lives. Traditional fake news detection models focus on incorporating writing styles, or world knowledge (e.g., triples). Nevertheless, writing styles are easy to imitate. Different from world knowledge, in this paper, we propose a novel hierarchical language knowledge-driven fake news detection (HLKFND) framework. More specifically, we first conduct entity linking to obtain the entity words for a given news text after removing stop words. We also extract the specific topic words through the LDA (Latent Dirichlet Allocation) for the news text. Then, we acquire the extended entities context through an external knowledge base for the extracted entity words. Next, we extract language context (the sememe of a Chinese word based on the HowNet) for the extracted topic words. After that, we construct a powerful language-entity graph that includes the previous words in the news text, the extended entity context, and the extended language context. Finally, we successfully combined the language context and the entity context under a graph convolutional networks framework. Our experimental results demonstrate that our HLKFND outperforms strong recent baselines on Chinese benchmark dataset in fake news detection.

articleTitle: Factors Influencing Users' Intention to Adopt Intelligent Customer Service: A Task-Technology Fit Perspective
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: This paper aims to examine factors influencing users' intention to adopt intelligent customer service. This study proposes a model by integrating the Task-Technology Fit (TTF) model and the concept of Technology Readiness (TR). An online survey was conducted to collect data from 308 participants. The results of the data analysis show that the fit between task, technology and personal characteristics has significant effect on users' intention to adopt intelligent customer service. This study extends the Task-Technology Fit model in the field of artificial intelligence, and offers insights to business interested in developing and designing intelligent applications.

articleTitle: Surface Defect Detection Method for Steel Bar Based on Correction Attention YOLOF
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In order to accurately detect the surface defect of steel bar in the rolling process in real time, a surface defect detection method for steel bar based on correction attention YOLOF is proposed. Taking the YOLOF as the backbone network in this method. And a correction attention network branch fused with YOLOF is designed, which uses the gray correction module and outlier segmentation module to construct the input and output channel for parameter learning, and the intermediate features generated by the attention network module are fused with the features of the YOLOF, which are used to enhance the contextual semantic information. The results show that compared with the original YOLOF, the mean average precision (mAP) of the proposed method is improved by 7.69%. In addition, in order to verify that the correction attention network branch has generalization ability and improve the detection effect, the branch is added to TinyYOLOv3 and SSD512 respectively, increasing the mAP by 6.85% and 4.98% respectively.

articleTitle: An Interpretable Question Answering Method Based on Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Community question answering has gradually become the primary path for people to acquire knowledge. Existing community answer prediction research mainly faces the challenges of multi-type entity feature fusion and low answer interpretability. In this paper, we propose an interpretable Question Answering Method Based on Heterogeneous Graph Neural Networks, called IQAGNN. Firstly, we construct a heterogeneous information network to fuse multi-type entity relationships in question answering communities. Secondly, we employ the heterogeneous graph neural network to obtain multi-type entity embeddings. Finally, we predict the answer to the new question based on entity correlation and give an interpretation analysis of the answer via meta-paths. Comparative experiments on three real datasets show that IQAGNN has advantages in interpretive question-answering research.

articleTitle: Analysis of key nodes in airline network based on complex networks
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: We select the airline network as the object of study, calculate the characteristic parameters of the airline network via complex networks theory, and point out its small-world network characteristics and degree distribution obeys the exponential distribution. The nodes in the airline network are ranked according to degree centrality, closeness centrality, betweenness centrality, eigenvector centrality and semi-local centrality, and we derive the important nodes by analyzing the centrality. In addition, it is found that the network has poor destruction resistance by recording the changes of network efficiency under deliberate and random attack. These results will provide contribution to the development of airline's network.

articleTitle: User Clustering Based on the Topic-Sentiment Analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Nowadays, more and more people communicate and comment on what they care about on social platforms. In order to determine the distribution of topic-sentiment in microblog comment text more accurately and efficiently, this paper combined the improved TF-IDF parallel algorithm and Latent Semantic Model to construct the topic-sentiment model for user clustering. Firstly, we carried out data pre-processing and semantic role tagging. Then, we used the improved TF-IDF parallel algorithm to calculate the eigenvalues and sentimental polarity values of each sentimental word, and then the topic-sentiment words table was established. Finally, we established a Latent Semantic Model for the data of users' topic sentimental polarity value, extracting eigenvectors of users, and clustering users with the same eigenvectors by K-means algorithm. Compared with the traditional models, the result of the experiment showed that the proposed model has better accuracy, recall rate, F1 and time performance.

articleTitle: A Mechanism and Control Design of Flexible Spine driven by Pneumatic Artificial Muscles
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In order to further improve the bionic characteristics of the quadruped robot and enhance its stability and flexibility of motion, in this paper, we designed a flexible spine driven by pneumatic artificial muscles (PAMs). Firstly, inspired by the Hooke's Joint, we complete the design of spinal mechanism with 2 rotational DOFs, which is driven by 4 parallel PAMs, and achieve feedback of posture by using 2 encoders fitted on sides. Furthermore, in order to enhance the mechanism's loading capacity, we adopt the X-shaped controlling layout of PAMs instead of cross-shaped controlling layout of that. Secondly, we use proportional-integral-derivative (PID) algorithm to control the spinal mechanism and tested its performance through tracking step, sine as well as central pattern generator (CPG) planning trajectories. Finally, we analyze experimental data and the results show that the tracking performance meet the predetermined requirements.

articleTitle: Oil Spill Detection in SAR Images based on Improved YOLOX-S
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In order to identify the oil spills rapidly and accurately in SAR images, a detection method of oil spills in SAR images based on improved YOLOX-S was proposed. First, data enhancement and other pretreatment measures were done for collected SAR images of oil spills; second, improved FFDNet was used to reduce the speckle noise in SAR images, thus reducing the influence of things which were similar to oil spills on experimental results; finally, in order to fully extract the features of oil spills in SAR images, ECA module was added into YOLOX-S model to improve the identification accuracy of oil spills in SAR images. The experimental results showed that the improved YOLOX-S model could reduce the speckle noise in SAR images to some extent and identify quickly and accurately the oil spills in SAR images with accuracy rate of 86.76%.

articleTitle: Scheduling Strategy of Virtual Device Based on Wake-up and Semi-sleep Mode
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In order to meet the request and response requirements of users and further improve the efficiency of the computer system, a new type of virtual device scheduling strategy is proposed by integrating the wake-up and semi-sleep mode. At the end of a semi-sleep period, if the number of user requests waiting in the buffer reaches the wake-up threshold, the virtual device will transition from the semi-sleep state to the wake-up state to serve user requests at a normal rate. Otherwise, the virtual device will restart a new semi-sleep period to continuously provide low-speed services for user. According to the principle of scheduling strategy, a multi-service desk queuing model with policies and multiple asynchronous work vacations is established. Using the quasi-birth-death process and the matrix geometric solution method, performance indicators such as the average sojourn time requested by users and the energy-saving rate of computer system are deduced. Comprehensive numerical analysis experiments and computer system simulation experiments are used to evaluate the computer system performance of the virtual device scheduling strategy.

articleTitle: The Novel Estimation Model of Parallel Minimum-Computing-Time Node Size
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: It is time-consuming to test parallel program, which has become one of the bottlenecks in applying parallel software. In this paper, we intensively study the essence of parallel program when it is running, and point out that the parallel computing time can be expressed by the amount of computation. Based on this, a mathematical estimation model is proposed. In this model, the parallel computing time function is expressed by mathematical formula, and the parallel node size can be calculated when the derivative is zero. The calculated parallel node size is the reference value when the parallel computing time is shortest. This model can greatly reduce parallel program running time, and can also supports platform-independent handling by calculating the derivative, which ignores the influence of the unit data computing time and the running system's software and hardware. The experimental results indicate the effectiveness of the discussions.

articleTitle: Application of Cointegration Theory on Degradation Feature Extraction of Rolling Bearing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Generally, in different bearing condition monitoring data, the degradation features representing the health status of rolling bearings show different trends and do not have a consistent evolution process. In order to synthesize and unify the monitoring data of states under different working conditions between different bearings and find consistent degradation features, the cointegration theory is applied to the extraction of degradation features of rolling bearings in this paper. Through the experiments on the whole life data of three laboratories under five working conditions, the similarity between features is calculated by dynamic time warping (DTW) method. The results show that the consistency of the proposed features is at least 2.3 times and at most 11.4 times that of a single feature, which further verifies the advantages of the proposed features in consistency. Principal component analysis (PCA) and isometric mapping (Isomap) algorithm are compared with cointegration fusion, and the proposed features are proved to have better two-stage performance.

articleTitle: Extending the Control System by Integrating AI Models
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: The integrated computer control system (ICCS) of the largest high-power laser facility in China plays a significant role in experimental shot orchestration. To deduce the time and manpower consumption in two important control stages, namely the closed-loop control of arbitrary pulse generation (AWG) and detection of near-field anomalies, we design intelligent algorithms respectively. To address the issue of platform incompatibility when integrating intelligent algorithms into the existing integrated computer control system, intelligent algorithms are implemented in a servitization fashion. The new AI-integrated software of AWG waveform closed-loop control and near-field anomaly detection obtain a great time efficiency improvement.

articleTitle: Study on the spatial and temporal distribution of pavement friction coefficients at the tunnel entrance of mountain highways
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: The analysis of the spatial and temporal distribution law of pavement friction coefficients at tunnel entrances of mountainous highways is conducive to improving the safety of traffic at tunnel entrances in winter, and the combined prediction process of pavement friction coefficients at tunnel entrances of mountainous highways is proposed. The data of road surface temperature and humidity were collected in the field, and a prediction model of road surface temperature and humidity at the tunnel entrance was constructed using a bi-directional long and short term memory neural network (Bi-LSTM) model. Combined with a large number of indoor friction coefficient tests, the relationship between friction coefficient and temperature and humidity under different pavement conditions was established, and then the Equal Friction Coefficient Line (EFCL) of the tunnel entrance pavement was proposed to determine the distribution range of friction coefficient under the ice and snow environment at the tunnel entrance and the unfavorable spatial and temporal area of traffic safety with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{EFCL} < 0.4$</tex>. The results show that the spatial and temporal regions with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{EFCL} < 0.4$</tex> are the tunnel entrance regions with clear sky periods of 5-7 h, −200 m to +50 m from the cave entrance and periods of 23-9 h, −25 m to +25 m from the cave entrance. The snow time period is 23∼4 h for the whole area of the tunnel entrance, providing data support for the tunnel entrance traffic safety and security technology.

articleTitle: Joint Spatio-spectral Patterns for Motor Imagery-based Brain-Computer Interfaces
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Spatio-spectral filtering technique plays a vital role in extracting electroencephalography (EEG) features for motor imagery (MI)-based Brain-computer interfaces. How-ever, most of the existing methods often require many EEG channels for high performance. In this study, we propose a novel method, called joint spatio-spectral pattern (JSSP), for obtaining discriminative spatio-spectral features under the condition of a few-or single EEG channel. The proposed JSSP method finds the combined spatial-spectral filter from the time-frequency representations of EEG signals. It not only can utilize the potential information hidden in time and frequency domains, but also can effectively implement even based on a single-channel EEG signal. The performance of the proposed JSSP has been tested on the dataset IVa of BCI Competition III. Experimental results demonstrate the effectiveness of the proposed method.

articleTitle: Underwater Sound Source Localization Based on Time-Reversal Mirror and Virtual Array
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In order to overcome the complexity of acoustic channel's multipath, the principle of obtaining spatial gain by time reversal mirror (TRM) is proposed. The signal-to-noise ratio determines the effect of TRM. This paper presents a signal processing method which constructs a virtual array to heighten the signal-to-noise ratio by using the reflection characteristics of water-air interface. The effectiveness is verified by underwater experiments. The results show that this method can effectively improve the positioning accuracy of underwater sound source.

articleTitle: An Efficient Data Analysis Method for Typical Meteorological Year Development Considering Climate Change During the Past Decades
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In order to explore the impact of abrupt climate jump phenomenon on typical meteorological year (TMY) data used to simulate building energy consumption, this work was carried out. Firstly, the moving t-test method was applied to analyze abrupt climate jump phenomenon using the hourly weather database from 1960 to 2019 provided by the China Meteorological Data Center. All meteorological parameters involved in the TMY were analyzed by moving t-test method. Secondly, according to the time scale requirements of the original data for TMY's construction, it generally required original data 10 to 30 years ago. Therefore, the climate jump point that meets the above time scale requirements is considered as the climate jump point in this region. The year of the climate jump point is set to the beginning and ending of the time scale of the original data used to construct TMY. Thirdly, based on the above method, this study takes Beijing and Zhengzhou in China as examples. The calculation results show that there are two climate jump points in Beijing, and their years are 1988 and 2014 respectively; and Zhengzhou has one climate jump point, and the year is 1988. Therefore, the TMY's time scales of Beijing and Zhengzhou considering the abrupt climate jump phenomenon are 1988-2014 (total 27 years) and 1998-2019 (total 22 years). Finally, this paper compared the differences between old TMY and new TMY considering abrupt climate jump phenomenon.

articleTitle: Beer fermentation control system design based on S7-1200PLC
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: With the continuous development of China's national economy, small-scale fine chemical production technology has gradually emerged in the chemical field. Due to the wide variety of small fine chemical production, to facilitate research, mainly the beer fermentation process as an example, this paper uses Siemens S7-1200PLC as the basic controller, and the PID system and control panel are integrated into the monitoring software to prevent the interference of external factors in the control process and cause the system control parameters to be unstable. This project designed a set of economical and practical PLC control system, the system through the operation of the PLC and its actuator, automatically adjust the temperature and pressure of the beer fermentation process, to achieve high quality, low-cost purposes. At the same time, the system also has the functions of display storage, printing, and alarm of parameters.

articleTitle: Ultra High SNR 3D Imaging Clustered LiDAR Technique for Underwater Targets
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Underwater imaging is an interesting and challenging topic in field of lidar due to the absorption and scattering of light by water, which decreases the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) of effective laser echo signals and thus reduces the imaging distance and quality. In this paper, an ultra high SNR cluster LiDAR technique for the underwater targets 3D imaging is proposed. The results of the formula derivation and calculation indicate that the SNR can be increased by 10 log <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$(\boldsymbol{M}\times N)/k$</tex> dB of the clustered LiDAR. Based on the theory of the cluster, the imaging quality can be improved by the analysis and simulation. Therefore, the research of the cluster LiDAR has the significance for the underwater targets 3D imaging in the future.

articleTitle: Flight test Methods of SINS Borderline Performance Based on Quasi-level Uniform Design
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: The requirements of the traditional flight test method of SINS inertial navigation performance only includes the flight route and sample size. With the improvement of borderline performance requirements for weapon equipment test and appraisal in the new period, it is urgent to re-examine whether this method can fully stimulate the dynamic error of SINS and meet the demand of “finding out” the borderline performance of equipment. Firstly, compared and analyzed the specific requirements of relevant standard documents for SINS flight test, and completed the modeling of dynamic error propagation characteristics. Meanwhile, this paper used the simulation test method with quasi-level uniform design, to evaluate the main factors which affecting dynamic error, and finally designed the flight test verification programme of SINS inertial navigation performance.

articleTitle: Research on high-voltage discharge arc detection method based on binocular stereo vision
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Electromagnetic interference caused by high voltage discharge is one of the common problems in modern society. The arc generated by high-voltage discharge is extremely harmful to human body and device. However, the traditional detecting methods of arc are frequently limited by environment and instruments used for detection, so they are incapable of monitoring and detecting the arc timely and effectively. As its low cost, simple system and wide applicability, binocular stereo vision technology has been widely used in environmental monitoring, image detection and other fields. This paper studies the detection method of high voltage discharge arc based on binocular stereo vision, and accomplishes the non-contact, rapid and effective detection of high voltage discharge arc. By setting up a simple binocular stereo vision and high voltage discharge system, the characteristic point cloud of high voltage discharge arc is obtained, and the point cloud is filtered by differential calculation to reconstruct the three-dimensional image of discharge arc. The experiment shows that this method can effectively detect high voltage discharge arc, and the feasibility of high-voltage discharge arc detection method based on binocular stereo vision is further verified.

articleTitle: Extended State Observer Based Nonsingular Terminal Sliding Mode Control for a Class of Dynamic Systems
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: For the problem of tracking control of a class of dynamic systems, an extended state observer based nonsingular terminal sliding mode control is proposed by sufficiently considering nonlinear characteristics and external disturbance. Firstly, in order to estimate and compensate the unknown total disturbance item of dynamic systems, the extended state observer is designed. Secondly, the nonsingular terminal sliding mode controller is designed to ensure that the tracking error converges to zero in finite time. Finally, abundant simulation results validate the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: Research and Practice of Remote Sensing Crop Water Consumption Monitoring Platform in China
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: As a key link in water cycle, evapotranspiration (ET) contains over 60% of the total precipitation. ET is also vital component of global energy balance, which has a proportion of 60 present of net radiation. Since ET plays a critical role worldwide, especially in water management, it has been studied extensively in the past decades. To meet the actual needs of practical application for management departments at all levels in China, we developed a remote sensing-based monitoring platform to provide real-time estimation and short term forecast of water consumption and requirement without manual operation and maintenance. The platform built in a series of standard remote sensing and meteorological data processing program and a simple but robust forecast method was used and validated at 9 different regions that covers major grain producing areas and climatic zones. Results showed that the accuracy of water requirement forecast is over 80% up to 40 days leading time. By far, the demo of the platform is launched, and daily results were uploaded and stored in cloud server and provide online preview and data download to the whole public.

articleTitle: Research and application of improved k-means algorithm based on educational big data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: This paper aims to conduct in-depth mining of student performance data. It is helpful to provide teachers with teaching strategies and improve teaching quality. Compared with the previous research on the k-means algorithm, the main innovation of this paper lies in the selection of the initial cluster center and providing teaching strategies for universities. First, we collect the students' transcripts of three subjects and process the original data including cleaning data, extracting key fields, and integrated processing of data. Then, we use the k-means algorithm, to get the cluster center and the category. Finally, we visualized the clustering results.

articleTitle: A Novel Face Recognition Algorithm Based on Numerical value of Facial Feature Points
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: To improve the speed of querying the relevant information of the face by inputting the face image puts forward a face recognition method of numerical value based on the face facial feature points distance ratio. First, the face image is collected through the camera equipment and preprocessing image. Second, perform face detection and key point location on the image, and select some main key points. Third, calculate the distance between every two points, choose n distances from it that have more influence on the face difference, calculate the ratio of this n distance, and use it as a data feature of the human face. Comparison with the search time of the deep convolutional neural network of the face images set. It can see that extracting the seven feature points of the facial features and converting the face image into twenty-one-dimensional data can effectively promote the human face retrieval speed while ensuring accuracy.

articleTitle: Research on improving social service ability of local university libraries based on Wuhan City Circle
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: As an important platform for gathering documentary and information resources, local university libraries naturally play an important role in serving local social and economic development. Local university libraries in Wuhan city circle should be based on locality, take the construction of information resources as the basis, take innovative services as the fulcrum, promote the construction of Wuhan city circle and help the construction of Wuhan national central city as its main purpose, improve various social information service systems, take the initiative to serve local governments and enterprises in the city circle, provide information services and support for the conversion of technical achievements of the universities in which they are located, and serve the economic and social development of the city circle.

articleTitle: A note on equivalence between the standard and nearly perfectly matched layers for the second-order wave equation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: By either rigorously or approximately transforming the mapped wave equation from the complex stretched coordinate system to the real one, the standard perfectly matched layer (PML) or the nearly PML (NPML) can be obtained. The two are equivalent for the first-order wave equation but not for the second-order one. Over the past two decades, two parallel literatures have emerged, one about the PML and the other about the NPML. Although the PML and NPML are theoretically equivalent regarding absorption efficiency, the suggestion has been that the NPML is superior regarding (i) implementation complexity, (ii) computational efficiency, and particularly (iii) memory efficiency. The present paper restructures the PML formulation to halve its memory efficiencies. Compared with the current formulation, we show that in fact the PML and the NPML are almost equivalent regarding these three aspects. Moreover, when the classical coordinate stretching function is used, the PML is superior to the NPML.

articleTitle: PLC-based control system design of integrated bagging and stalking and grading snapping sorter for pears
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Aiming at the problem of low efficiency in the process of pear picking and processing, excessive investment of manpower, and easy damage of fruit affecting the income of fruit farmers, we designed a pear picking and comprehensive processing all-in-one machine with PLC as the core control module, combined with 3D printing technology, software design principle, mechanical design principle and photoelectric sensor. The machine realizes the three functions of cutting handle, removing the bag and netting for pears, which includes five mechanisms: conveying mechanism, handle cutting mechanism, bag tearing mechanism, bag blowing mechanism and netting mechanism. In the Mitsubishi GX Works2 software to complete the program writing and debugging, the results meet the requirements of the machine motion control.

articleTitle: A Review of the types of disturbances and suppression methods for SiC MOSFET driver
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In recent years, wide-bandgap semiconductor devices have developed rapidly, and their usage in various power electronic devices is also increasing. Among them, SIC MOSFET devices have the advantages of high temperature resistance, high voltage resistance, and fast switching, so as switching devices, they have been widely used in various power electronic topologies. However, the higher switching frequency and various driving interference factors make the driving module of SIC MOSFET need higher quality. In order to make better use of SIC MOSFET and ensure that it can switch stably in the circuit, it is necessary to study the driving design method of SIC MOSFET. This article expounds and summarizes the types of disturbances encountered by SiC MOSFET drivers and their suppression methods. Firstly, the basic status and basic conditions of SiC MOSFET device driving are introduced. Then it is explained that under different driving conditions, the kinds of disturbances received by driving are different, and their effects are also different. Finally, the methods of suppressing interference are summarized and compared.

articleTitle: A Joint Extraction Strategy for Chinese Medical Text Based on Sequence Tagging
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: The research on entities and relations extraction in medical text is the basis of constructing medical knowledge graphs. Currently the mainstream pipelined extraction method do not consider the connection between entity recognition and relation classification, and could not address the problem of the overlapping relations among the triplets. This paper proposes a joint extraction strategy of entities and relations in chinese medical based on sequence tagging, which splits the joint extraction task into two sequence tagging subtasks, namely HE and TRE, establishing the connection of subtasks through shared encoding layer and semantic information of head entity. By incorporating the pre-trained language model RoBERTa to obtain a richer numerical representations of word vectors, then fusing word vectors and part-of-speech vectors as inputs of word representation for joint extraction, in combination with the GRU-BiLSTM model to extract entities and relations directly. Experimental results show that this model achieves 54.44% F-value on the chinese medical dataset CMeIE, which outperforms the extraction performance of other pre-trained language models.

articleTitle: Power System Fault Diagnosis Based on Multi-Sensor Data Fusion for Large-Scale Railway Maintenance Equipment
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In order to solve the defects in the accuracy, reliability and applicability of the current tamper diesel engine fault diagnosis, this paper establishes the causes of symptoms and the corresponding sample sets, introduces the concepts of fuzzy logic and fuzzy neural network structure for the complexity and fuzziness of engine tampering, and applies them to the turbocharger tampering system. Finally, using Matlab simulation, the results show that the combination of neural network and fuzzy logic can provide a more detailed description of the fault phenomena compared with the commonly used neural network and fuzzy theory fault diagnosis methods, making up for the respective deficiencies of fuzzy theory and neural network. It has good application prospects in the field of fault diagnosis of large railroad maintenance equipment

articleTitle: A New Design of Vehicle Lean Management System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: The thesis thoroughly analyses the vehicle management situation of China's state-owned enterprises, through taking the example of the vehicle lean management system of one large-scale central energy enterprise in some province of China, conducts management and technological innovations on such aspects as the lean management of vehicle assets, efficient operation management, multi-dimensional cost lean management, digital management decision-makings of vehicles as well as management platform construction of vehicles, and builds core applications such as vehicle assets management, operations management, expense reimbursement, drivers APP and digital billboards, realizing lean management and digital management for near 10 thousand vehicles of this central enterprise. The research and application of this case provides important reference for boosting the transformation towards lean management and digital

Author Keywords: management of vehicle of governments as well as enterprise and public institutions

articleTitle: Eye-tracking-based robotic arm control system
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: People with severe speech and motor impairments are unable to actively use their muscles, with the result being that they have difficulty communicating with the external world. In this study, we developed a non-invasive robot-arm control system based on eye tracking. We conducted a user-centered design process with eight commands and an intermediate real-time video transmission user interface after fully considering the spatial characteristics of the robotic arm. Additionally, we evaluated three eye-gaze point processing algorithms. Among them, density-based spatial clustering applied with a noise algorithm achieved an average accuracy of 99.3%. On this basis, we designed and conducted offline experiments, in which all five participants were able to send commands with accuracy higher than 99% for a total of 80 random commands.

articleTitle: Image-Based Automatic Crack Detection Method of Gantry Crane Track
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Aiming at the technical problems of intelligent identification of cracks on gantry crane track, a target detection method was proposed based on machine vision and deep neural network. YOLOv5s is used as the surface defect detection model, and the trained YOLOv5s model is used to recognize the crack of the gantry crane track. Because of the lack of training sets, the affine transformation is used to increase the sample size of the training set, and the data set is trained to get preliminary weight for the transfer learning method. Also, the Gaussian smoothing image method is adopted to improve the model's accuracy. The test results show that the track crack detection model developed based on YOLOv5s is effective. The test accuracy P, recall rate R, and mAP reach 0.995,0.993, and 0.996, respectively. The developed method is helpful for the construction personnel to evaluate the health condition of gantry crane track crack accurately.

articleTitle: A readout circuit for CNTFET-based infrared image sensor
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Carbon nanotubes field effect transistor (CNTFET) have great potential in the construction of 3D monolithic infrared image sensors because of their excellent material properties, low-temperature undoped technology and functional integration. In this paper, a silicon-based readout circuit is designed as the follow-up processing circuit of 3D integration of CNTFET-based infrared image sensor. The readout circuit includes programmable integrator, sample and hold (S&H) circuit and 10bit/10MHz Successive AppRoximation Analog-to-Digital Converter (SAR ADC), which obtains good noise performance and large output dynamic range. The AFE is fabricated with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$0.18 \mu\mathrm{m}$</tex> 1P6M mixed-signal process occupying active area of 1.2mm<sup xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">2</sup>. In 1.8V power supply and 5kHz bandwidth, the post-simulation results indicate typical Signal-to-Noise and Distortion Ratio (SNDR) is 54.13dB and Effective Number of Bits (ENOB) is 9.28bits. The detecting resolution reaches 0.32nA with total 4.12mW power consumption.

articleTitle: Neighborhood Focused Critic Policy Gradients for Multi-agent Reinforcement Learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Centralized Training and Decentralized Exucetion (CTDE) is typical training pattern in multi-agent reinforcement learning. In actor-critic method, the actor updates based on the centralized critic which takes global state as criteria for individual contribution. While in cooperative multi-agent tasks, estimating individual contribution in the range of all agents leads to the overlook of local coordination, and thus intensify the mislead in credit assignment. This paper propose Neighbourhood Focused Critic (NFC) Policy Gradients for multi-agent reinforcement learning, parameterizing critic by neighbourhood focused graph neural network in Actor-critic method. NFC allows the centralized critic focus on local coordination in each agent's neighbourhood, and decentralized actors optimizes policies according to the critic estimation, thus alleviating the credit assignment problem. We test our NFC in StarCraft Multi-Agent Challenge (SMAC) environment, the results show that it improves performance and convergence speed significantly comparing to methods with globally focused critic.

articleTitle: Planning and Design of Urban landscape Based on GIS: Taking Dongcheng District of Beijing as an example
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: GIS technology is widely used in many fields, such as surveying and mapping, planning and design, environmental management, culture and education, etc., with its scientific, efficient and intuitive advantages. This paper will review the application of GIS in the planning and design of Urban landscape, summarize the advantages of GIS in the planning and design of Urban landscape, and take Dongcheng District of Beijing as an example, analyze the area through GIS technology, and draw corresponding conclusions, which will provide reference for future study and research. (Abstract)

articleTitle: Distribution grid fault diagnosis based on SR-GRU and fault indicator
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Efficient utilization of massive recorded data from fault indicators in distribution grid is beneficial to improve fault diagnosis. In this paper, the state detection and fault diagnosis of distribution grid based on fault indicator data were realized by combining high-dimension statistical analysis and artificial intelligence methods. Spectral residual algorithm was used to obtain saliency map of fault recorded data in rolling time windows, which can filter out useless background information. By training the distribution grid fault diagnosis model based on saliency map, a GRU network with high real-time and accuracy was obtained, and the overall accuracy of fault diagnosis reached 98%. The distribution grid fault diagnosis based on SR-GRU can not only make efficient use of massive fault indicator data, but also improve the universality and intelligence of the distribution grid fault diagnosis.

articleTitle: A Study on the Parameters of Barrier-free Elevator Control Panel and the Optimization Strategy for the Visually Impaired
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In this modern age of rapid technological advancement, the planning and design of public spaces and building facilities should accommodate the needs of persons with disabilities and inability to perform activities of daily living, thus achieving “barrier-free” design. Taking the visually impaired as the research object, in this paper, the preferences of the visually impaired and the sighted for parameters of the barrier-free elevator control panel, such as raised height, radius and angle of inclination are studied through literature review, interview, experiment and analysis, and the strategy for optimizing elevator control panels is proposed based on the habits of using elevator control panels by the visually impaired and the sighted generalized from interviews and experiments, with the aim to achieve “barrier-free” use of elevators by the visually impaired and the sighted.

articleTitle: Dynamics Analysis of Railway Piggyback Transportation Vehicle in Piggyback Transportation System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Based on the research on the dynamic test results of the piggyback transportation system, this paper analyzes the influence of vehicle vibration acceleration on the running stability of the vehicle during the operation of the railway piggyback transportation vehicle. The results show that the increase of vehicle speed from 90km/h to 130km/h will increase the longitudinal vibration acceleration of the railway piggyback transportation, and the value will increase from 0.64g to 0.98g. The lateral acceleration has little effect and the values are below 0.4g, but at a running speed of 130km/h, the smoothness effect caused by the vibration acceleration is above the safety level of two or more.

articleTitle: Underwater positioning method based on polarization characteristics
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Underwater polarization positioning is mainly to determine the heading by calculating the position of the solar meridian through the polarization distribution patterns. However, in the actual environment, the polarization state of light will be changed by atmospheric scattering, water surface refraction and underwater scattering, resulting in the reduction of the accuracy of solar meridian extraction. In this paper, a method of extracting solar meridian based on RANSAC is proposed. Firstly, the polarization images are denoised by Gaussian filter, and then the underwater polarization distribution pattern is obtained. Then the position feature points of the sun and the solar meridian are extracted by iterative threshold method. Finally, the direction of the solar meridian is fitted by RANSAC algorithm, and the carrier orientation is calculated by the angle between the body axis and the solar meridian. Simulation experiments are conducted to analyze the performance of the proposed method and the least square method under the same noise conditions. The results preliminarily confirm the effectiveness and accuracy of the proposed method in underwater environment.

articleTitle: ESR Calutation Model of Metalized Film Capacitor in WPT System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Metalized film capacitor is widely used in compensation networks for magnetic resonant wireless power transfer (WPT) system. As an essential design parameter, equivalent series resistance (ESR) of film capacitors will cause severe heating and shorten the life of the capacitor during operation. In this paper, the loss model is proposed by analyzing the loss mechanism of the film capacitor. Based on the measured data of KEMET R76 series film capacitors, the relationship between the tangent of loss angle (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\text{tan}\!\delta$</tex>) and operating frequency and capacitance is analyzed, then the calculation model of ESR is proposed. Finally, the calculated value is compared with the measured value to prove the calculation model's correctness and feasibility, which is very important to optimize the loss of compensation network and WPT system.

articleTitle: An optimized wood knots recognition scheme based on double detection
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: To improve the accuracy of wood knots recognition based on computer vision especially the live knot which got similar color with the surroundings, an optimized network architecture was proposed in this study. The model we created was consisted of two parallel networks to cope with two kinds wood defects: light and dark to improve the robustness of the model in color diversity. It was thought that the two well trained networks would be capable of recognizing of any kinds of wood defects between the two typical colors. To avoid repeated recognition of one object cause by the double detection, a decision making mechanism was established based on classification scores to determined the right category. The model was validated by using wood plates which contained 4 kinds of knots. It was shown that the double detection could successfully recognize live knots as well as other defects. The increased accuracy could be attributed to the using of parallel networks which enhanced the implicit feature of live knots. Instead of using complex CNN architecture like some classic models, the proposed method increased the accuracy of wood defects recognition by using parallel networks with relatively simple structure, which increased the speed of model thus was more suitable for industrial application.

articleTitle: Research on Fast Beam Alignment Technology at Target Area Based on Swarm Collaboration Control Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In this paper, in order to reduce the total time for aligning all laser beam of an large-scale laser facility at target area, a fast convergence control mode of beam swarm alignment based on the swarm collaboration control mode was constructed, and a beam alignment fast convergence algorithm was designed on the basis of this model. According to the data which was collected at the facility site and running data in the 8-bundle serial alignment mode, the algorithm was simulated for 20 shots. The simulation results show that the algorithm can greatly reduce the average alignment time of 8 beams, from 233.7s to 162.2s, and the reduction rate is greater than 30%. The algorithm proposed in this paper has a certain reference for the design and engineering application of large-scale laser facility.

articleTitle: Quality assessment for super resolution image via feature optimization
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Objectives: Most of the existing no-referenced (NR) image quality assessment (IQA) methods need to extract lots of image features and then predict the image quality. However, only a small part of these features plays a role in IQA models while the other makes the model inefficient. Therefore, a NR IQA framework based on feature optimization is proposed and applied it to the field of super-resolution (SR) IQA task. Methods: The features associated with the SR images are first collected and aggregated. Secondly, a variety of advanced feature selection algorithms are used to sort the feature sets and get the importance matrix of features. Then the linear correlation between the number of features and Pearson linear correlation coefficient (PLCC) is studied according to the importance matrix of features to determine the optimal number of features and the optimal feature selection algorithm. Results: In this paper, the image quality scores predicted by the model based on the aggregation feature are highly consistent with the human subjective scores. Using the proposed feature optimization framework, we can effectively reduce the number of features and make the model performance better. Conclusion: In this paper, feature engineering is used to optimize the performance and efficiency of existing NR IQA algorithms. Experimental results show that the image quality can be accurately predicted by only a small part of image features.

articleTitle: Research On The Influence Of Wearable Equipment On Sports Under The Background Of Information Technology
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: With the rapid development of information technology, the reference of information technology has spread to all walks of life. The monitoring of sports is beneficial for people to carry out physical exercise scientifically and efficiently, improve people's physical fitness and health level, and use information technology to provide wearable sports for sports. The monitoring equipment will provide guidance for people to live a healthy lifestyle. This research mainly starts from the integration of information technology and wearable equipment technology, the impact of wearable equipment on sports, and the development trend of wearable equipment, and studies the impact of wearable equipment on sports under the background of information technology., through this study, it lays a foundation and reference value for the research on the impact of wearable equipment on sports.

articleTitle: Research on SAR Image Processing Performance Based on OpenMP and CUDA Parallel Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In the field of remote sensing image processing, Synthetic Aperture Radar(SAR) image has a large amount of data and takes a long time to process. Especially in the military field and disaster detection, conventional serial processing methods cannot meet the requirements of real-time performance. To solve this problem, the high-performance computing advantages of parallel processing are utilized. The optimization effect of SAR image processing performance was studied based on OpenMP shared memory parallel processing method and CUDA parallel model. Combined with the use of OpenCV computer vision library, basic image processing tasks and parallel processing framework were designed. According to the comparison of the execution time between parallel processing and serial processing, the SAR image preprocessing speed is increased by 2 to 16 times. It is concluded that the parallel computing model is an effective fast SAR image processing optimization scheme.

articleTitle: Relationship value in the Digital Era: New Ideas for the Communication of National Trendy Brands: - Taking China Li Ning as an Example
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In the Paper, the communication contents of China Li Ning on Weibo and bilibili were taken as the main research object. In addition, text mining technology was used to analyze and study the methods for the brand to mine and build relationship value from the perspective of communication. From such two paths of user-user relationship and brand-user relationship, China Li Ning's application of relationship value in brand communication was studied by using keyword extraction, semantic network analysis and emotion analysis. In this study, the user-user relationship was constructed by the creation of communication topics and contexts and the embedment of them into existing user relationship networks; while the brand-user relationship was consolidated through the path of “recycling of interest-creation-interaction-feedback”. New ideas for the brand communication of national trendy brands in the digital era can be provided according to the results of the study.

articleTitle: AMSNet: Attention-based Multi-Scale Network for Image SR Reconstruction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Image super-resolution reconstruction (SR) aims to find the mapping relationship between a low-resolution (LR) image and the corresponding high-resolution (HR) image. At present, the SR methods based on deep learning still has the problem of blurred edges and loss of details in the reconstruction results. To address these issues, we propose an attention-based multi-scale SR network (AMSNet), In order to better learn the global and local features of images, a multi-scale network structure is designed to reconstruct richer image features. In the multi-scale structure, cascaded residual blocks (CRB) are used to extract image features. Additionally, a Squeeze-and-Excitation-based residual upsampling block (SERUB) is designed to enhance important features that are beneficial to image reconstruction. Extensive experiments show that our network has better performance in image reconstruction compared to some other state-of-the-art models and is able to reconstruct image texture details better.

articleTitle: Research on crack identification of tunnel lining based on image processing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Tunnel engineering is mostly related to the national economy and people's livelihood, and its operation safety is very important. Tunnel safety accidents or potential safety hazards often start from subtle points. Therefore, the identification of tunnel cracks is the key link of tunnel safety control. The development of computer technology makes it possible to automatically detect tunnel cracks. Aiming at the low recognition accuracy of existing crack recognition algorithms, according to the characteristics of tunnel images, the improved homomorphic filtering algorithm is used to defog and clear the collected images, and the adaptive median filter is used to denoise the gray images. The extended difference of Gaussian function is used for edge extraction, and the open and close operations of morphology are used to remove noise. The breakpoints of binary images are connected after noise removal, so that the images are more in line with the actual situation. Aiming at the identification of tunnel crack types, the block index is put forward and used to distinguish linear cracks from net cracks. Using histogram-like method to distinguish linear cracks in different directions can solve the mixed cracks in images. Compared with the traditional method, the recognition rate of the new algorithm is improved to 94.5%, which is much higher than the traditional crack recognition algorithm.
