The average processing time of the image is 5.2 s, which is a medium processing time, and the accuracy rate of crack type discrimination is more than 92%. In a word, the new algorithm has a good theoretical popularization prospect and high engineering application value.

articleTitle: Prediction of rolling bearing performance degradation degree based on SELSTM
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: The construction of performance degradation indicator of rolling bearing is a key step to predict the degree of performance degradation.In order to reduce the dependence of the construction process of rolling bearing performance degradation indicator on priori artificial knowledge and effectively predict the degree of rolling bearing performance degradation, a rolling bearing performance degradation prediction model (SE LSTM) based on multi feature fusion of channel domain attention mechanism (SE) and LSTM is proposed.Firstly,extracts the time and frequency domain featuresof rolling bearing, the higher dimension after input to the SE LSTM model, through the model of channel attention network (SENet) on the featuresof the various channels give a suitable weights to represent the importance of the various characteristics, and weighted summation, the featuresof each channel to generate a one-dimensional performance degradation indicator , Then the performance degradation indicator is input into the LSTM network to predict performance degradation.Through experimental verification, compared with the model constructed with the best single feature as the performance degradation indicator , this method reduces 19.12% in RMSE and 29.51% in MAE. It is proved that the model can achieve good results in the prediction of bearing performance degradation.

articleTitle: Study on characteristics and simplified function of pedestrian head injury criterion (HIC) based on mathematical analysis
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: As an important evaluation reference of head injury, head injury criterion (hereinafter referred to as HIC) has been applied for more than 50 years. It is often cited not only in the automotive industry, but also in the fields of sports injury and medical biomechanism. Derived from the aggregate data of pedestrian protection test, this paper modelized six representative acceleration waveform and cubic function. In accordance with the methodology of mathematical and theoretical analysis, the HIC function has been simplified into an expression only related to the coefficients of the cubic function and verified. In the process, two inherent characteristics of HIC have been summarized, and a new method for solving HIC has been established.

articleTitle: DP-BEGAN: A Generative Model of Differential Privacy Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In recent years, differential privacy has gradually become a standard definition in the field of data privacy protection. Differential privacy does not need to make assumptions about the prior knowledge of privacy adversaries, so it has a more stringent effect than existing privacy protection models and definitions. This good feature has been used by researchers to solve the in-depth learning problem restricted by the problem of privacy and security, making an important breakthrough, and promoting its further large-scale application. Combining differential privacy with BEGAN, we propose the DP-BEGAN framework. The differential privacy is realized by adding carefully designed noise to the gradient of Gan model training, so as to ensure that Gan can generate unlimited synthetic data that conforms to the statistical characteristics of source data and does not disclose privacy. At the same time, it is compared with the existing methods on public datasets. The results show that under a certain privacy budget, this method can generate higher quality privacy protection data more efficiently, which can be used in a variety of data analysis tasks. The privacy loss is independent of the amount of synthetic data, so it can be applied to large datasets.

articleTitle: Research and application of electric power inspection technology based on intelligent wearable
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: At present, the information management of substation protection hard plate is totally dependent on manual inspection. With the rise of AI to national strategy and the further development of in-depth learning technology, a plate state recognition method based on in-depth learning OpenCV+SSD network model is proposed. Firstly, on the basis of image binarization, corner detection of protective screen cabinet is carried out based on Hough linear detection algorithm. Through perspective transformation, the plate image is corrected, so as to avoid the influence of the angle change of the photographed image on the recognition results. Secondly, the template matching method is used to segment the image of the press plate, and the mapping relationship between different press plates and their functions is established to improve the accuracy of the state detection of the press plate. Then, a target detection model of SSD is built based on the TensorFlow deep learning framework, and the accuracy and generalization ability of the training model are improved by adjusting the parameters continuously and using regularization processing. The test results show that the target detection accuracy and recall rate of this method are both greater than 0.95. Compared with the traditional opencv and Hog + SVM processing methods, the recognition effect of press plate state has been significantly improved.

articleTitle: Advance Algorithms of Secchi depth Remote Sensing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: As a new observation method, ocean remote sensing technology can obtain a large range of seawater transparency distribution characteristics in quasi real time. In recent years, ocean water color remote sensing technology has developed rapidly, especially the increasing number of water color remote sensing devices and the improvement of the accuracy of relevant algorithms, which make the remote sensing of sea water transparency get great development. This paper summarizes the research and development of ocean transparency remote sensing platform, analyzes several typical algorithms of sea water transparency remote sensing, and summarizes the current development status of sea water transparency remote sensing, so as to provide some theoretical reference for the research and further development of this field.

articleTitle: Computer Simulation of Freeze-thaw Cycle in Long'en Hall of Zhaoling Mausoleum in Shenyang City, China
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: The frost damage of ancient buildings is caused by freeze-thaw cycles in winter. In this study, the data of field investigation and infrared thermal imager testing were used as a reference for CFD computer simulation settings to simulate the influence of the solar radiation during daytime and the water freezing at night in Long'en Hall. We found that the solar radiation during daytime has been the main reason for the temperature rise of materials. The larger the solar elevation angle was, the higher the surface temperature would be, with the maximum value 33.5 °C. At night, the temperature dropped to −9°C until after 3.33 hours (12,000s). The water content in the pores would freeze completely, resulting in cracks and peeling of materials in the future. Through the correlation between the actual measurement and the simulation results, it has been proved that the selection of simulation parameters was reasonable, and CFD computer simulation can provide a reference for the research on damage and weathering of architectural heritage in winter.

articleTitle: Design of collaborative computing mining truck automatic driving system based on AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: The high complexity and high computational resource requirements of the autonomous driving system require it to be designed not only to meet requirements of stringent integrity and security, but also to be iteratively updated over the life cycle of the vehicle as external systems evolve. In addition, the heavy mining trucks are severely bumped on the rough mining road, making the expensive lidar on the mining truck very vulnerable to damage, and if all sensors are deployed on the mining truck, there will also be a problem of excessive processing unit load. Aiming at the above problems, a design scheme of cooperative computing mining truck automatic driving system based on AUTOSAR Adaptive Platform is proposed. The design scheme includes a cloud control and management system, a vehicle control and management system and a road detection and identification system. The three-in-one, coordinated operation not only meets the needs of the automation and intelligence of the mining truck autonomous driving system, as well as unified management, operation and maintenance, but also supports high performance and collaborative computing, secure and reliable communication mechanisms and flexible software configuration capabilities.

articleTitle: Extended State Observer Based Sliding Mode Control for a Class of Dynamic Systems with Input Constraint
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: This paper is devoted to developing an extended state observer based sliding mode control method to realize the robust tracking control for a class of dynamic systems with input constraint. Firstly, in order to avoid system input saturation, auxiliary subsystem is introduced. Secondly, the extended state observer is used to estimate the total disturbance item of dynamic system including nonlinearity and external disturbance term. Then, by combining the Lyapunov stability theory, an extended state observer based sliding mode tracking controller is proposed to ensure that the tracking error system can be driven onto the sliding mode surface, and the asymptotic convergence of the tracking error is guaranteed. Finally, corresponding simulation results are carried out to illustrate the effectiveness of the proposed control method.

articleTitle: A New Method to Extract Impedance between Input and Output Cables in Radiated Frequency Band of Power Converter
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: When the radiated CM current flows on the isolated power converters with long input-output cables, radiation will be formed in space. The coupling between the input and output cables creates the antenna effect. Based on the existing radiation noise model, accurate extraction of antenna impedance is very important to calculate the radiated CM current and predict radiation noise. This paper proposes a new antenna impedance extraction method, which comprehensively considers the coupling between the antenna and coaxial cables when measuring antenna impedance with a two-port network analyzer. The coupling is reduced to ground impedance by <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\pi$</tex>-type model, thus improving the accuracy. To verify the correctness of the proposed method, Ansys HFSS is used for simulation comparison, and the final simulation results are in good agreement with the measured results.

articleTitle: Spectral Unmixing Model Based on Non-negative Matrix Factorization with Spatial and Spectral Correlation Constraints
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Spectral un mixing has been an important technique for hyperspectral imagery processing. In spectral unmixing methods that are based on the original non-negative matrix factorization (NMF) model, unmixing accuracy is limited by the lack of appropriate constraints that derived from the inherent properties of hyperspectral images. It was shown that the correlation analysis can be extended for NMF-based spectral unmixing model, based on the advantage that the spatial and spectral correlation features can provide necessary constraints for NMF to overcome related problems and obtain better performance. However, many correlation constrained NMF models prefer adopting only spatial correlation, the neglect of spectral correlation may limit the accuracy and application scope. This letter presents a novel method of imposing spatial and spectral correlation constraints simultaneously on the NMF-based unmixing model by adopting Markov Random Field (MRF) and complexity pursuit respectively. The related issues, including reducing the deviation of endmembers' spatial energy distribution and substituting the predictability of signal for piecewise smoothness of spectra, were studied together. Experiments showed that the new proposed NMF model was superior to some existing NMF models with only spatial correlation constraint in terms of estimation accuracy of endmember spectra and fractional abundances.

articleTitle: On The Online Social Interactions in Knowledge Building Community
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Numerous studies have been conducted on knowledge building community (KBC), many of them are on the structure and application of the community, while online social interaction behaviors play an important role in building the community knowledge and sustained idea improvement. The aim of this study is to investigate students' online social interaction behaviors on KBC based on Edmodo platform. SNA was administered to analyze the data that had been collected through a sample of 46 students who were members of the KBC. Analysis using Ucinet was utilized to examine the cohesion, density and centrality of the network. The research findings have implications for the development and construction of online social interaction in practice.

articleTitle: SA-EfficientNet: Quality grading model of Stropharia rugoso-annulate
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In view of the poor consistency and low efficiency of the traditional sensory evaluation method, it is difficult to meet the market demand of the quality grading of Stropharia rugoso-annulate (hereinafter referred to as Stropharia). A quality grading model of Stropharia is proposed, which balances the three factors of network width, depth and image resolution and integrates the attention mechanism. This research improves the EfficientNet model, introduces the SA (Shuffle Attention) module, effectively combines spatial attention and channel attention, enhances the weight of useful features, improves the ability of feature extraction, and enhances the robustness of the model. The experimental results show that the average recognition accuracy of the improved SA-EfficientNet on the five level Stropharia data sets collected on the experimental platform is 91.5%, which is 1.4 percentage points higher than that of the original EfficientNet model. Compared with VGG16, ResNet50, DenseNet169 models, the accuracy is improved by 7.3%, 1.6% and 3.9% respectively. The improved SA-EfficientNet has better feature extraction ability, balances the grading accuracy and model complexity, performs well in the image grading task of Stropharia, and provides a reference for the quality grading of edible fungi.

articleTitle: The dynamical analysis of the electroencephalogram rhythm oscillation for the epileptic prediction
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Epilepsy is one of the most refractory brain diseases in the worldwide, and millions of people are suffering from the various symptoms of the epilepsy. Prediction of epilepsy emerges to be critical for the improvement of the auto-control equipment of epilepsy. In this paper, we have presented potential predictor for the epileptic seizure onset in the view of the rhythm oscillation based on the CHB-MIT scalp electroencephalogram (EEG) database, together with the recent reference analysis. The results show that: firstly, the alpha-beta band power emerges to be significant before the absence seizure onset. Meanwhile, the recent reference showed that the alpha-beta oscillation can also be found in the neighboring regions of the seizure regions that shows an offensive role of the healthy region for the epileptic spread. We propose that the alpha-beta can be potential prediction algorithm for epilepsy, and controlling its presence still could be promising pathway for the epileptic treatment.

articleTitle: Human motion prediction based on bidirectional feature sequence learning
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Dynamic analysis of human behavior is an important research branch of computer vision and pattern recognition field in recent years. In order to enable the computer to predict the intention of future action posture in advance by monitoring human body's early behavior, a behavior prediction model Bi-Seq2Seq is proposed in this paper, which is based on the integration of Bi-GRU unit and Seq2Seq model. Bidirectional Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU)is introduced into the encoder of traditional Seq2Seq structure to integrate forward and reverse features. It breaks away from the limitation of temporal order and effectively combines context information. The decoder part still adopts one-way GRU unit. The experimental results show that the human behavior prediction model based on bidirectional feature sequence reduces the prediction error of Smoking, Posing, Greeting and Sitting movements, with the maximum reduction up to 0.52. The short-term prediction accuracy of attitude prediction algorithm within 400ms is improved.

articleTitle: Analysis on Data Simulation of Spatial Resolution of Resistivity Based on Audio Magnetotelluric Method
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Audio Magnetotelluric Method (AMT) is universally adopted in hydrogeological exploration, engineering geological exploration and environmental geological exploration for its characteristics in easy operation with high lateral resolution. Forward modeling of AMT under the complex geological structure e proves to be imperative in pretty complex ield working environment, which is presented with combination of complex geological masses such as fault and embedment [1]. Therefore, the resolution ability of AMT to complex geologic masses in the case of high and low resistance interbed is studied by forward modelling, regular ization inversion and fast relaxation inversion of uniform half-space initial mode, so as to provide a reference for the numerical simulation of AMT. It is demonstrated in this paper that:(1) Uniform half-space is recommended as the initial model for inversion in areas with poor quality of original data; In the area with excellent quality of original data, the Bostick transform section of original data is recommended as the initial mode.(2) Different results will be obtained by different inversion algorithms for the same set of data, so it is necessary to learn how to analyze the trade-offs and get favorable information for exploration;(3) The vertical resolution of geological masses failed to be improved by encrypting frequency points within a logarithmic interval.

articleTitle: Modular Analysis on Increasing Chinese Economy Based on Complex Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Since the reform and opening up, China's economic growth has shown a strong and lasting trend, but the trend of economic growth among different regions has always been different. How to measure this difference and how to distinguish the correlation of economic development among provinces are the urgent problems in macroeconomic modeling. This paper employs the modular analysis method of complex network based on the correlation analysis of quarterly GDP data of mainland China's thirty-one provinces, autonomous regions and municipalities (excluding Hongkong, Macao and Taiwan) for nearly The results show that the average correlation of inter provincial GDP development weakens with respect to time, but the number of constituent modules of provinces, autonomous regions and cities Moreover, the results also show that the provinces have adopted more flexible Moreover, the results also show that the provinces have adopted more flexible autonomous development strategies, which can better meet the requirements of economic growth under the new situation. complex network and other data processing methods can extract more new indicators for macroeconomic research, and also provide a new research This study shows that dynamic complex network and other data processing methods can extract more new indicators for macroeconomic research, and also provide a new research perspective.

articleTitle: Application of deep learning in nondestructive evaluation of metal microstructural grain size
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In order to solve the problem of low detection accuracy caused by the lack of artificial prior knowledge, the complexity of grain scattering mechanisms and the limitations of ultrasonic evaluation methods, this paper proposes an intelligent method for the grain size evaluation of metals based on the Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) by laser-ultrasonics. The pulse echo signal transmitted by the bottom surface of the titanium alloy sample was obtained by the laser ultrasonic detection system. The wavelet time-frequency graphs of laser ultrasonic waveforms were obtained based on complex Morlet wavelet basis functions with different center frequencies and bandwidths. They were chosen as the input of the CNN model constructed by the Visual Geometry Group Network (VGGNet) with a large number of small convolutional kernels and pooling layers. The VGGNet model was trained, optimized and verified by the wavelet time-frequency graph sets. The results have shown that the model can accurately predict the grain size range of metals.

articleTitle: Research on Calculation Method of Differential Pressure in Irrigation Pipe Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In order to calculate the pressure difference of irrigation pipe network system, the topology of irrigation pipe network is transformed into a binary tree structure, and the relative pressure difference of each node of the pipe network is traversed by using binary tree in the first order for different specifications of branch pipes, capillary pipes and pipe network laying methods, etc. The optimal problem of distance between two points with real number of weights is solved.

articleTitle: Asphalt Pavement Crack Image Screening by Transformer-Based Model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: The traditional digital image processing algorithms and Convolutional Neural Network (CNN) models cannot reach the ideal level in the accuracy of asphalt pavement crack image screening. We introduce Vision Transformer (ViT), a Transformer-based method for automatic classification of asphalt pavement images. ViT consists of linear projection layer, embedding layer, transformer block and MLP head layer. To verify the ability of ViT on the crack image screening task, we use asphalt pavement datasets from two sources, and use a transfer learning-based strategy to fine-tune the model after obtaining the weights pre-trained by ViT on the ImageNet dataset. The performance of the ViT model is compared with three popular deep learning models, in which ViT achieves 98.5% accuracy and 99.2% F1 Score on the self-collected asphalt complex pavement dataset. The results showed that ViT and its variants performed better than the classical CNN network Resnet50 in the task of screening asphalt pavement cracks. The image screening method of asphalt pavement cracks based on Transformer performs well and has good research prospects.

articleTitle: Character Recognition And Printing Quality Inspection Of Chips Under Packaging Film
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: At present, tape reel packaging is widely used in semiconductor industry for the packaging of finished chips. Most of the incoming material inspection of tape reel packaging chips are traditional human visual inspection, which is slow and subjective. In this paper, machine vision technology is used to replace human visual inspection, the objective and accurate real-time inspection of the character recognition and the printing quality of chips under packaging film are realized. Using of polarized light source can effectively suppress the reflection of packaging film and realized high-quality image acquisition of the chip under packaging film; A characters OCR recognition technique based on MSER and deep learning is proposed, taking into account the speed and accuracy of character recognition; The high quality characters regional template is obtained by multi-image training and the morphological regional comparison method is adopted, which can effectively cope with the fluctuation of character grayscale and font thickness within a reasonable range and improve the accuracy of character printing quality inspection.

articleTitle: Short term wind power prediction based on improved quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm and kernel extreme learning machine
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In order to improve the prediction accuracy of wind power prediction model, a short-term wind power prediction model based on improved quantum particle swarm optimization kernel extreme learning machine is proposed. The differential evolution algorithm is introduced into the standard quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm to enrich the diversity of the search population. In addition, the Gaussian perturbation strategy is used to increase the local optimization ability of the algorithm. The improved quantum particle swarm optimization algorithm is used to optimize the parameters of the kernel extreme learning machine. Finally, the short-term wind power prediction model is established by using the optimized KELM and the actual wind farm data. The results show that the proposed model has high prediction accuracy.

articleTitle: Geological Disaster Emergency Decision Support System based on Location-Based Service
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Most Tibetan areas are extremely difficult in production and living conditions. With the rapid uplift of the Qinghai-Tibet Plateau, its geology, landform and climate have changed dramatically, resulting in frequent geological disasters such as collapse, landslide, debris flow, debris flow and glacial lake outburst floods. It is difficult for emergency rescue forces to reach on time and the emergency rescue teams also lack advanced technologies to support the emergency disposal. The health and life safety of the rescue personnel are often threatened. This paper discusses the construction of a geological disaster emergency decision support system based on WebGIS technology and supported by location-based service and satellite communication technology. It realizes business functions such as comprehensive management of geological disaster data, quick report of disaster and danger, three-dimensional desktop deduction of the emergency plan, monitoring and dispatching of rescue personnel, etc., to reduce the loss of people's lives and properties caused by geological disasters while improving the safety and security capacity of emergency rescue personnel, to achieve the purpose of emergency rescue.

articleTitle: Anomaly detection based on memory-augmented in computer room laboratory
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Computer room laboratory is a place to store servers, its security is very import, the way manual monitoring to monitor the abnormal of the computer room monitoring video is time-consuming and laborious, it is efficient to detect the abnormal conditions in the monitoring video of the computer room laboratory based on deep learning. Therefore, this paper proposes anomaly detection based on memory-agumented in computer room laboratory, and collected and processed the anomaly detection dataset of computer room laboratory. The model proposed in this paper uses the automatic encoder as the basic network and the anomaly discrimination method based on reconstruction, but the automatic encoder “generalizes”, in this paper, memory enhancement module is applied in automatic encoders, that suppresses the reconstruction of abnormal sample. In order to extract spatiotemporal features efficiently, interaction-reduced channel-separated convolution network is used as the video feature extraction network, which makes the memory module saves memory items with better performance and accurately reconstruct normal sample. The detection accuracy of the model of this paper is 90.68% in the anomaly detection dataset of computer room laboratory.

articleTitle: Research on dual mode control of micro-grid based on switching system theory
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In this paper, the switching between micro-grid grid connected state and island state is studied, and the stability of micro-grid system in a state space is analyzed under the switching fuzzy control method. Using the switching fuzzy method, the grid connected state and island state are regarded as two subsystems. The controller of the subsystem is designed by using the multiple Lyapunov function method and PDC method, and the reasonable switching law is designed. The feasibility and stability of the method are verified by simulation.

articleTitle: Improved differential privacy K-means clustering algorithm for privacy budget allocation
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In the differential privacy clustering algorithm, the added random noise causes the clustering centroids to be shifted, which affects the usability of the clustering results. To address this problem, we design a differential privacy K-means clustering algorithm based on an adaptive allocation of privacy budget to the clustering effect: Adaptive Differential Privacy K-means (ADPK-means). The method is based on the evaluation results generated at the end of each iteration in the clustering algorithm. First, it dynamically evaluates the effect of the clustered sets at the end of each iteration by measuring the separation and tightness between the clustered sets. Then, the evaluation results are introduced into the process of privacy budget allocation by weighting the traditional privacy budget allocation. Finally, different privacy budgets are assigned to different sets of clusters in the iteration to achieve the purpose of adaptively adding perturbation noise to each set. In this paper, both theoretical and experimental results are analyzed, and the results show that the algorithm satisfies e-differential privacy and achieves better results in terms of the availability of clustering results for the three standard datasets.

articleTitle: Feature Fusion Method based on Discriminant Correlation Analysis for Land Use Classification with Few-Shot
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Due to the particularity of spatial structure in geographic data and the inadequacy of labeled data, the deep learning features can not reflect the spatial information and scale changes of objects in land-use/land-cover (LULC) images. To overcome these limitations, a feature fusion method is proposed to obtain well-discriminative and low-dimensional features, which can effectively fuse the features extracted from different levels. Given the inadequacy of labeled data, a pre-trained deep convolution neural network is proposed and used as a feature extractor to obtain the semantic features of images. To overcome the variety of scale and rotation in LULC images, the scale-invariant feature transform feature is introduced to represent the spatial structure information of the LULC images. Then different features are fused for LULC classification. In order to effectively distinguish easily-confused categories, an improved discriminant correlation analysis method based on the distance of scatter matrix between different categories is designed. The distance coefficient minimizes the correlation among categories. The proposed methods are applied on the UC Merced land use dataset, and achieve outstanding classification performance with dozens of feature dimensions under the case of limited training samples. The results demonstrated that the proposed method outperform several state-of-the-art methods.

articleTitle: The Application of Internet Online Teaching Technology in Theory Teaching
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Objective: This paper discusses the application of online teaching combined with offline teaching method (BOPPPS, LBL) in biochemistry teaching. Methods: Taking Class 1 and Class 3 of nursuing undergraduate of Grade 2019 in Anhui Sanlian University as the research object, with Class 1 as the control group and Class 3 as the experimental group and students' evaluation of teaching, teachers' evaluation of students' learning process, final examination result and final score as the indicators, the BOPPPS teaching mode and the LBL mode were compared. Results: There was no statistical significance in age and critical thinking between the two groups of students (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{P}\ > \ 0.05$</tex>); 10 items of teaching evaluation were statistically significant (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{P}\ < \ 0.05$</tex>), and the other 5 items were not statistically significant (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{P}\ > \ 0.05$</tex>); teachers' evaluation of students' learning process was statistically significant (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{P}\ < \ 0.05$</tex>); the final examination result was not statistically significant (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{P}\ > \ 0.05$</tex>); the final score was statistically significant (<tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$\mathrm{P}\ < \ 0.05$</tex>). Conclusion: the BOPPPS teaching mode is obviously better than the LBL in online, and can stimulate students to participate in the teaching process, improve students' interest in learning, and enable teachers to optimize the teaching process using online platform.

articleTitle: Differential Privacy High-dimensional Data Publishing Method Based on Bayesian Network
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Ensuring high data availability while realizing privacy protection is a research hotspot in the field of privacy-preserving data publishing. In view of the instability of data availability in the existing differential privacy high-dimensional data publishing methods based on Bayesian networks, this paper proposes an improved MEPrivBayes privacy-preserving data publishing method, which is mainly improved from two aspects. Firstly, in view of the structural instability caused by the random selection of Bayesian first nodes, this paper proposes a method of first node selection and Bayesian network construction based on the Maximum Information Coefficient Matrix. Then, this paper proposes a privacy budget elastic allocation algorithm: on the basis of pre-setting differential privacy budget coefficients for all branch nodes and all leaf nodes in Bayesian network, the influence of branch nodes on their child nodes and the average correlation degree between leaf nodes and all other nodes are calculated, then get a privacy budget strategy. The SVM multi-classifier is constructed with privacy preserving data as training data set, and the original data set is used as input to evaluate the prediction accuracy in this paper. The experimental results show that the MEPrivBayes method proposed in this paper has higher data availability than the classical PrivBayes method. Especially when the privacy budget is small (noise is large), the availability of the data published by MEPrivBayes decreases less.

articleTitle: Coverage Detecting of Sweeping Robot Based on Binocular Vision
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Nowadays, the existing sweeping robots' coverage detecting methods for cleaning evaluation mainly use a monocular camera to estimate the movement trajectory of robot in a small scene. Such methods under small scenes using a monocular camera with a small viewing angle cannot be well used in the standard indoor environment specified by the Chinese national standard. Aiming at such problems, a coverage detecting method based on binocular vision is proposed. This method utilizes a binocular camera instead of a monocular camera to cover the detected standard environment in a large field of view. The binocular camera images are aligned horizontally based on the binocular stereo calibration method, and the camera images are unified by calculating the rigid body transformation matrix between the two cameras. Then the real-time position of the sweeping robot can be recorded based on the plane Marker detected. As the result, the movement trajectory can be obtained to calculate the final coverage rate. The coverage detecting results show that the proposed method is more reliable than the method used by the SGS quality inspection agency.

articleTitle: A modified logisticMF Method based on experts and data characteristics for electric power applications
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Based on the electric power data of Pudong Electric Power station in Shanghai, the model training and experiment are carried out with one million magnitude negative control data. Based on the logisticMF algorithm as the theoretical support, the abnormal data recommendation model is established on the basis of experts and data characteristics. The existing traditional recommendation method is automatic distribution methods, which has problems of chaotic distribution and low recommendation accuracy. Based on the recommendation model of logisticMF, this paper integrates the characteristics of expert attributes, user preferences and data labels, and puts forward the ABDR-LogisticMF model (Abnormal Data Recommend logisticMF) suitable for power data recommendation service. Experimental results show that the accuracy of the proposed ABDR-LogisticMF model is higher than that of automatic distribution, which can fully meet the recommended business requirements of the current number of abnormal data, and also provides support for subsequent distribution mechanisms of other abnormal energy data.

articleTitle: A Unilateral Compensation Network With Any Constant Current Output in WPT System
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: The compensation network in the wireless power transfer (WPT) system directly affects the performance of the system and is one of the research focuses in the WPT technology. Considering that the transmitter side and the receiver side are challenging to resonate simultaneously in the existing compensation network, the compensation capacitance of the transmitter side cannot be used in some special applications. Based on the multi-solvability of the transformer T-network model, this paper deduces the principle of unilateral compensation to achieve constant voltage or constant current output. It proposes a series-parallel (/SP) compensation network structure that can realize any stable current output characteristics. The structure obtains different transfer admittance characteristics by compensating and controlling the leakage inductance impedance on the receiver side. The experimental results verify the correctness and feasibility of the theoretical analysis.

articleTitle: Analysis of Traffic Characteristics of Dynamic Open Hard Shoulder Road Based on SUMO
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In order to alleviate the congestion of expressway, based on Jingxiong expressway, the expressway traffic flow model is constructed by SUMO software. The secondary development is carried out through TraCI interface and python programming language. The speed standard deviation, lane changing speed, density, departure delay and operation delay are proposed as the traffic flow evaluation indexes of hard shoulder open sections, and the impact of different speed limit schemes on road traffic characteristics after hard shoulder opening is analyzed. The results show that hard shoulder running can improve the traffic capacity of Jingxiong expressway by 22.5%, and the optimal traffic volume range of hard shoulder opening is 8000–9800 pcu/h. With the reduction of the overall speed limit in the open section of hard shoulder, the standard deviation of speed continues to decrease, and the density and operation delay show an increasing trend. In the free flow state, the number of lane changes increases with the reduction of the overall speed limit of the road section. In the case of congested flow, the impact of the gradual reduction of the speed limit of the road section on the total number of lane changes is weakened. When the road is not congested, opening the hard shoulder can reduce the departure delay by 100%. After the road is congested, the departure delay is reduced by about 60% compared with that when the shoulder is not open.

articleTitle: Research on the Technology of Power Adapter Without Input Electrolytic Capacitor Based on One-Cycle Control
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: High power density is the key to power adapter miniaturization, and it is also one of the research hotspots of the power adapters. Aiming at the problem that the input electrolytic capacitor affects the volume of the power adapter, a topological structure of the power adapter without input electrolytic capacitor is proposed in this paper. This topology adds an energy compensation loop based on the flyback converter. The balance between input instantaneous power and output power is realized by controlling the charge and discharge of the energy storage capacitor in the energy compensation loop to reduce the low output voltage ripple. The working principle and switching mode of the topology is analyzed in detail, the key parameters of the circuit are designed for the proposed circuit topology, and a control strategy for the circuit topology based on one-cycle control is proposed. Finally, the circuit topology and control principle is verified by simulation at 60W. The simulation results show that the proposed circuit scheme can reduce the output voltage ripple to less than 0.3% at 60W, and eliminate the input electrolytic capacitor, which greatly reduces the volume of the power adapter.

articleTitle: A novel design for a gated recurrent network with attentional memories
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Recurrent neural networks (RNN) are used for pro-cessing the temporal dynamics of complex sequential information. Existing recurrent neural networks, such as Long Short-Term Memory (LSTM) and its variant, Gated Recurrent Unit (GRU), are used to control current and historical information. This study proposes a novel design for a gated recurrent neural network with an attention mechanism, named the Attentional Memory Unit (AMU), which gives the recurrent neural network an attention capability. This design uses a gated mechanism and a generalized attention mechanism so that it can be adaptively adjusted in the spatial and temporal sense to allow the application of the attention mechanism for different scenarios. The experimental results verify that the proposed AMU significantly boosts the power of RNNs.

articleTitle: Unified Framework for NER and RE Tasks with Strong Interpretability on Chinese Medicine Instruction Parsing
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Medicine instructions and related medical guide-lines could serve as valuable knowledge source to serious medicine Knowledge graph (KG) construction. To formulate these nonstructural texts into a well-defined structure, a pre-cise and efficient way to extract information from medicine instructions is needed. Two basic tasks of the extraction, i.e. the Naming Entity Recognition (NER) task and the Relation Extraction (RE) task, have been well studied in traditional way (such as templates) as well as deep neural networks (such as BERT-based models). However, sound interpretability is key to serious medical scenario, which almost rules out the direct application of deep neural networks. In this work, we propose a unified framework for NER task and RE task on Chinese medicine instructions, in which hierarchical dynamic templates serve as basic tools for both tasks. These templates are precise, flexible and strong-interpretable, and they are initially manually constructed and easily expanded in a bootstrap session with the help of distant supervision and BERT-based models. In another point of view, BERT-based models are effectively distilled by rules and manual check, resulting into a cluster of strong-interpretable dynamic templates. At the end of the day, a Chinese medical KG based on the exacted parse result of more than 30 thousand medical instructions was established, and then partly applied to a prescription pre-audit system, which led to more than 10% improvement to the prescription audit accuracy in eight primary hospitals.

articleTitle: Intelligent Ship Decision System Based on DDPG Algorithm
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: With the development of robot technology, intelligent ship decision-making becomes particularly important. Toward this goal, this research proposes a path planning and manipulating approach based on deep reinforcement learning DDPG algorithm, which can drive a ship by itself without requiring any input from human experiences. At the very beginning, a ship is modelled with the Nomoto model in a simulation waterway. Then, distances, obstacles and prohibited areas are regularized as rewards or punishments, which are used to judge the performance, or manipulation decisions of the ship. Subsequently, DDPG is introduced to learn the action-reward model and the learning outcome is used to manipulate the ship's movement. By chasing higher reward values, the ship can find an appropriate path or navigation strategies by itself. After a sufficient number of rounds of training, a convincing path and manipulating strategies will likely be produced. By comparing the proposed approach with the existing methods. The results show that this approach is more effective in self-learning and continuous optimization and thus closer to human manipulation.

articleTitle: A BERT-based Text Sentiment Classification Algorithm through Web Data
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In order to analyze the sentiment tendency of public opinion, this paper conducts a textual sentiment classification research through web data. In the research, this paper uses the BERT (Bidirectional Encoder Representation from Transformers) model to replace the commonly used word2vec model as a text vectorization tool, which has stronger semantic representation capabilities and can realize polysemous words. For the multi-label classification problem of reviews, the BR (Binary Relevance) algorithm is used to transform the problem into multiple binary classification problems, which is directly and efficient for processing multi-label data. Design the BiLSTM-Attention model, which combines the bidirectional long and short-term memory network and the attention mechanism to achieve further extraction of text features. After multiple sets of comparative experiments, the effectiveness of the BiLSTM-Attention model is verified through performance evaluation. In order to further improve the performance of the model, the problem of unbalanced data set is solved by adjusting the loss function and various parameters so that a better classification effect is achieved.

articleTitle: Research on 3D visualization technology of electromagnetic source arc based on machine vision
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Computer vision is an important research direction of machine learning, in which binocular stereo vision technology with the advantages of low cost, high speed, appropriate accuracy and simple process has been very mature. As an important perception technology for computer passive detection, binocular stereo vision technology has been widely used in 3D reconstruction, feature detection and other fields, but its application in electromagnetic environment detection and electromagnetic visualization is still limited In this paper, a three-dimensional visualization technology of electromagnetic source based on machine vision is proposed Using binocular camera as sensor and visual SLAM technology, the three-dimensional point cloud image of electromagnetic source high-voltage discharge arc is obtained, the three-dimensional reconstruction of electromagnetic source is carried out, and finally the visualization of 3D point cloud electric and magnetic source arc is realized Through the imaging detection experiment of electromagnetic source arc, the three-dimensional point cloud image of electromagnetic source discharge arc is obtained, which shows that the binocular stereo vision technology can detect the three-dimensional electromagnetic source discharge arc and the feasibility of the three-dimensional visualization method of electromagnetic source arc based on machine vision.

articleTitle: A Random Forest-based Operating System Recognition Algorithm for Network Security
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: With the development and popularization of the Internet, network security has become the focus of public attention. Operating system detection and identification is an important part of network security work, which has very important significance for its research. This thesis designs an algorithm of operating system identification based on random forest. Based on the third-party fingerprint database, this method constructs simulation data and maps it into a vector that can be learned by the algorithm. In order to construct a highly reliable and generalized resource fingerprint structure, a random forest algorithm is used to combine multiple weak fingerprints into Strong fingerprints to improve the accuracy of operating system recognition, and design a layered training architecture to achieve long-term expansion and maintenance of operating system fingerprint models based on random forest construction. The fingerprint similarity algorithm is adopted to measure the similarity between fingerprints, which provides a basis for the operating system to mark the card. Experiments show that this method can accurately identify the remote operating system, and has a better accuracy effect than the traditional static matching method.

articleTitle: Research on Torque Control Algorithm for Path Planning of Free Floating Space Robots Capturing Target
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Aiming at path planning problem of FFSR capturing moving targets, firstly, this paper establishes the kinematics model of FFSM, deduces the formula for effective calculation of GJM, and puts forward a fast algorithm for calculating GJM. Secondly, a dynamic model of FFSM is established. This method solves the velocity and angular velocity of each link of FFSM according to the angle and angular velocity of all joints of a given FFSM. According to the given angle, angular velocity and angular acceleration of all joints of FFSM, the angular accelerations and accelerations of each link of FFSM are solved. According to Newton's law and Euler's angular momentum equation, the forces and moments acting on the chain rod of FFSM are solved. Then an effective joint torque solution algorithm of FFSM is established. Finally, based on the GJM and joint torque fast solution algorithm proposed in this paper, combined with RMRC control strategy, a torque control algorithm for path planning of FFSM capturing target is proposed, which greatly improves the efficiency of FFSM motion control.

articleTitle: Prognostic analysis of patients with non-small cell lung cancer based on Bayesian network model
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Background To explore important prognostic influence factors and predict the survival in patients with non-small-cell lung cancer (NSCLC). Methods A training cohort of 22,150 patients diagnosed with NSCLC among 2000 and 2018 from the Surveillance, Epidemiology and End Results database (SEER) was collected and statistically described with Kaplan-Meier method. Log-rank method was used to compare the difference between groups. Cox proportional risk model was used to analyze the prognositic influence factors. What's more, Joinpoint model, nomogram and Bayesian network model were used to analyze the prognosis of patients. Results The incidence of non-small cell lung cancer increased before 2002 and then decreased. Gender, age, race, primary site, histological grade, pathological type, tumor size, AJCC, N stage, and primary site operation influenced the prognosis of NSCLC significantly with <tex xmlns:mml="http://www.w3.org/1998/Math/MathML" xmlns:xlink="http://www.w3.org/1999/xlink">$P < 0.05$</tex>. Overall survival (OS) and cancer specific survival (CSS) were predicted by the internal validation set with C-index of 0.773 (95%CI: 0.772-0.774) and 0.798 (95%CI: 0.797-0.799) respectively. Conclusion This nomogram prediction model has a good prediction effect for NSCLC prognosis, and the Bayesian network model can greatly improve the accuracy of the model, which can provide a reference for clinicians to make personalized diagnosis and treatment decisions for NSCLC patients.

articleTitle: Semi-supervised Medical Image Classification Combining Metric Pseudo-Label and Classification Pseudo-Label
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Deep learning networks with good performance often need a lot of data for training. However, in medical image classification, obtaining high-quality label data is time-consuming and depends on the professional knowledge of doctors. In this paper, a new semi-supervised medical image classification framework based on pseudo-labeling, which combines feature metric pseudo-labeling and model classification pseudo-labeling, and obtains supplementary information in the training process through prior information marked by model from unlabeled data. Considering a lot of information is abandoned in feature map extraction, we introduce an effective pseudo-label combination method, which combines the pseudo-labels obtained by different methods to potential information from unlabeled data. Compared with existing pseudo-labeling methods, our method obtains feature metric pseudo-labels by extracting image features, measuring image feature prototype from labeled data, and combines them with the pseudo-labels obtained by model classification. The performance of this model on skin lesion classification is better than most advanced semi-supervised learning methods.

articleTitle: Trolley Remote Control System Using Eye Motion Tracking
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: In this paper, a trolley remote control system based on eye tracking technology is proposed that controls the direction of the trolley's movement according to the gaze direction of the human eye. The system's graphical user interface contains eight arrows pointing in different directions that function as the gaze targets for moving the trolley in the corresponding direction. This paper compares two algorithms for detecting fixation points. One method clusters the gaze position of the human eye recorded by the eye tracker in the preset time window, and the other method directly uses the fixation point determined by the eye tracker's own software to construct a fixation heat map and then perform image processing. Through experiments, it was found that the average target detection accuracy of the system using the clustering algorithm (99.78%) is 3.13% higher than that of the system using the second method and the difference between the performances of the algorithms was found to be significant. The results demonstrate that in the trolley remote control scenario, the use of eye tracking technology with a clustering algorithm can realize efficient and natural human-computer interaction. Moreover, such a system has good sensitivity and stability.

articleTitle: Topic Detection of Multi-feature Fusion in the Financial Field
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: Financial-related texts represent relevant trends in the financial field and influence investors' decision-making and market trends. In order to efficiently and quickly obtain topic information from the massive financial texts, topic detection technology is used to obtain the topic information of financial texts. Considering the characteristics of financial texts, this paper extracts the features of the text from the three perspectives of subject, keyword, and entity, and the time attenuation factor is used to fuse the features. Then the text is clustered based on the combined single-pass clustering and neural network clustering algorithms to obtain the subject information of the text. The experimental results show that the above method can effectively mine the subject information of financial texts.

articleTitle: Industrial Part Image Retrieval Combining Convolution and Attention Features
publicationTitle: 2022 International Conference on Computer Engineering and Artificial Intelligence (ICCEAI)
abstract: The image retrieval of industrial parts aims at ranking parts of different classes based on the similarity of the content, so as to solve the common problems of informatization management in industrial production and improve production efficiency. Generally speaking, the images are ranked by comparing the similarity between the representation vector of the query image and the gallery image for retrieval. Therefore, a compact and rich feature representation has become the key to image retrieval. In this paper, we propose a new image retrieval framework, which combines the features extracted by convolutional neural network (CNN) and Transformer, and retains local and global information to the greatest extent through convolution and self-attention. Specifically, we co-training CNN and Transformer to generate image feature descriptors, and combine multiple metric learning loss functions to train the model. Experiments show that this method achieves high accuracy in image retrieval. For example, we obtained a rank-1 score of 87.1% on the button Re-ID dataset, which is significantly better than existing methods.
